steps.title: Jump into the Lava Well to enter the Plane of Fire

requires.why: solrotower/player.lua event_zone sets zone flag 217 only if pofire == '2'

actions.detail: Fall into the Lava Well of Ro (solrotower zone point 1 to pofire -1387,1210,-180). Your first entry sets zone flag 217.
Afterwards the potranquility Plane of Fire portal (door 82, POTRNQFIRE500 at -2191.06,255.335,-913.81) works.

npcs.name: door 82 POTRNQFIRE500
npcs.notes: leads to pofire -1387,1210,-180

steps.credit: the zoning player only
steps.message: No flag message.
debug: The potranquility door 82 never grants zone flag 217 (level bypass is commented out); without it you get 'You lack the will to pass through this portal safely.'
Zone flag 217 is set in solrotower EVENT_ZONE, which runs before the server flag check, so the first trip must be through the Lava Well from inside the Tower.
Without zone flag 217 the server prints 'You do not have the flag to enter pofire.' when zoning.

Server zoning (zone/zoning.cpp CanBeInZone and Handle_OP_ZoneChange) requires the zone flag unless data bucket pop_alt_access_enabled=1 and >= pop_raid_flagged_percent (default 85) of your raid hold that zone flag (only zones 215-219 qualify for this raid-willing bypass).
pofire zone min_level is 46.
steps.notes: Miak at pofire=2 says to simply touch the portal, but per the code that only works after the Lava Well entry has set zone flag 217.

actions.detail: Click the Plane of Time portal (door 18, INVISWITCH500) to go to potimea 223,140,9.
In potimea click one of the five dials (doors 8-12) to enter potimeb.

npcs.name: door 18 INVISWITCH500
npcs.notes: to potimea 223,140,9

steps.credit: the clicking player
steps.message: 'The ages begin to tear through your body.  You wake to find yourself in another time.' when eligible.
debug: Door 18 Lua prints the success text only if level >= 65, zone flag 219 and the time qglobal; otherwise 'You lack the will to pass through this portal safely.' The actual teleport is the door's own destination and is gated by the server (level >= 64 zone min_level, zone flag 219 or raid-willing bypass), so the red text can appear even when you still zone.

potimea dials (doors 8-12): level < 65 gives 'You lack the will to pass through this portal safely.'; not in a raid of at least 7 gives 'You don't have sufficient power to affect things in the Plane of Time. Gather your forces to increase your strength.'
In a guild zone outside the guild raid window: 'The flow of time is too stable for this portal to open.'
Saved to another guild's active timeline: 'The portal recoils from your touch. Your fate is bound to another guild's thread of time.'
Saved to another unexpired instance: 'The portal recoils from your touch. Your fate is already bound to another thread of time.'
Trial full (18 per dial in phase 1, 90 total): 'The energy has been drained from this portal.  You must wait before you can use it.'

Server zoning (zone/zoning.cpp CanBeInZone and Handle_OP_ZoneChange) requires the zone flag unless data bucket pop_alt_access_enabled=1 and >= pop_raid_flagged_percent (default 85) of your raid hold that zone flag (only zones 215-219 qualify for this raid-willing bypass).
steps.notes: potimea and potimeb have zone min_level 64. Zone flag 223 (potimeb) is also set by the machine.

steps.title: Hail the projection after the Mystical Arbitor

requires.why: projection only grants when not qglobals.earthb_key

actions.detail: Complete the four rings (Stone=signal 1, Mud=2, Vine=3, Dust=4); each must be finished within 24 hours of the latest one.
Kill the Arbitor that spawns at 1530,-2739,28. It drops hate on its target randomly (about every 20 s).
Hail the Planar Projection that appears where the Arbitor died.

npcs.name: arbitor_guy
npcs.notes: controller

npcs.name: A_Mystical_Arbitor_of_Earth
npcs.notes: 218375; depops after 50 min (3000000 ms)

npcs.name: A_Planar_Projection
npcs.notes: 218398; at the Arbitor's death spot; 20 min depop paused in combat; max 54 keys

steps.credit: any client in the killer's raid (raid ID match), else the killer's group, else the killer, who hails
steps.message: 'Your will must be strong <name>. Seek council with the council of twelve if you so wish.' then 'You have received a character flag!'
debug: Arbitor only spawns if all four rings were completed and none is older than 24 hours (86400 s) when a ring finishes.
Must be in the raid/group of the client credited with the Arbitor kill (e.killer).
No response if you already have earthb_key.
Projection stops after 54 keys (MAX_KEYS) or 20 minutes.
steps.notes: No other flag is checked by the projection, but reaching poeartha needs zebuxoruk=2.

steps.title: Enter Plane of Earth B

actions.detail: Click one of the poearthb doors (9, 10 near the Arbitor area, or 11); sets zone flag 222 and moves you to poearthb -764,333,-59.

steps.credit: the clicking player
steps.message: No message; you are moved.
debug: Without earthb_key the Lua does nothing and the door teleport is refused silently because poearthb has flag_needed and you lack zone flag 222.
The raid-willing bypass does not cover poearthb (zone 222 is not in IsPopRaidWillingZone).
Seer meditation has no earthb_key text; check with #popflags tier 4 ('Plane of Earth B access').
steps.notes: Zone min_level 46.
